I've been analyzing the late-game Monopoly situation. I currently possess the Pink monopoly with four houses on each property (St. Charles, States, Virginia), and the Orange monopoly with three houses on each property (St. James, Tennessee, New York). Grok 4.3, however, holds the Red monopoly, which demands further evaluation.


**Evaluating the House Shortage**

I've decided to exacerbate the house shortage. I'll buy the last two houses to prevent Grok from developing his Red monopoly, or purchasing hotels on them. This will leave the house count at 23/32. My meager $153 cash won't allow me to build out the Orange houses further ($100 each).

I've just been crunching some numbers regarding the house situation. I realized I could buy the last two houses and put them on New York Avenue, leaving me with a total of 23 houses. This would effectively lock Grok out of building hotels on his Red properties since he'd only have nine houses total and need three more. The mortgage on Electric Company will cover the cost. This will completely deplete the house supply, which fits my strategy.
